regime.summary: Policy rate held at 10.5% with the 6M bill cutoff slightly below it and CPI falling over three months, so the next move is likelier a cut than a hike, but the pack gives no date. Index is up strongly over 3-12 months but flat to down over 1 month, and foreign corporates and banks sold over 20 sessions. Neutral, modest core, no tactical entries.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 10.5%; last MPC decision 2026-01-26: hold (+0bp)

CPI YoY 5.79% for 2026-01 (published by 2026-02-03); three months earlier (2025-10) 6.25%

core.thesis: Fertilizer with its own catalyst rather than rate sensitivity, low P/E and a high dividend yield; mutual funds were net buyers of fertilizer in the last 5 sessions. Method lesson favours own-catalyst sectors over rate-sensitive ones. Holding is a valuation and income view, not a timing call.

evidence.quote: Lesson: favour sectors with their own catalyst over rate-sensitive ones.
